title: Rattle Family Friends
description: Rattle Family Friends — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Townston Commander

Quest Type: Hunt

Quest Description: Slay 2 Rattle Family Friends

Quest Reward: 7500 Gold and 4 Kings Coins

Return to: Townston Commander

Repeatable: No

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Kill the Two Rattle Family Friends on Level 4 of Vergrim's Vexation and Return to the Townston Commander in Townston.

Offer:

Ok, ready for your next task I take it. The next group of Rattle Family Friends is waiting for you on Level 4 of Vergrim's Vexation. Same deal as before, kill them and return to me for your reward and the next task.

Be careful, these Rattle Family Friends were close to the Rattles and they have a mean anger worked up for you. Do not take them lightly or it will be the last mistake you make before respawning and trying again. Once you have slain them return to me, the Townston Commander, here in Townston.

Turn-in:

Well done, I take it that they didn't put up too much of a fight. Here is your reward.

Objectives:

  • Slain Rattle Family Friend

Level range: 15–30
